mapper.select: SELECT d.*, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, s.category as s_category, s.price as s_price, s.unit as s_unit FROM order_detail d LEFT JOIN service_item s ON d.service_id = s.id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.*, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, s.category as s_category, s.price as s_price, s.unit as s_unit FROM order_detail d LEFT JOIN service_item s ON d.service_id = s.id WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_detail (order_id, service_id, service_name, quantity, unit_price, subtotal, remark) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{serviceId}, #{serviceName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{subtotal}, #{remark})
